The weekend is here, and the AirPods Pro 3 are still 25% off while the AirPods Max 2 are still $100 off. However, today's lead deal in the 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to $1,099 at the official Apple Refurbished Store, with all three colors in stock (that's $200 off) — this model usually sells out fast, so you'll want to jump on it quickly. We're also tracking up to $120 off the all-new MacBook Neo, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop down to nearly $100 off at Amazon, and the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable at an Amazon all-time low of $18 with free shipping for Prime members (effectively 40% off). Also check out the updated 2026 Best Buy back-to-school deals below.

AirPods Summer sale still going: Max 2 $100 off, AirPods Pro 3 from $99 at 25% off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $149 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 (ANC) $119 (Reg. $179) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 back-to-school sale: TVs under $500, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen appliances, more

Cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air back to $1,099 at official Apple Refurbished Store, all three colors in stock ($200 off)

The official Apple Refurbished Store has long been a great place to save money, especially after the MacBook line saw retail price increases. While Pro and M5 MacBook Air base configuration stock can fluctuate, this morning we spotted the base configuration 13-inch M5 MacBook Air available in all three colors at $1,099 — that's $200 below MSRP.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage at $1,099 with free shipping. As of writing, this deal is available on Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These products come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligibility to purchase AppleCare
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process before being resold

What you're seeing here is the base configuration M5 MacBook Air, which retails for $1,299 new. Today's Apple Refurbished Store deal is $200 below that MSRP, the lowest price we've tracked for the current model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

The Apple Refurbished Store may be the best place to buy a refurbished MacBook Air on the market, but how does it compare to the retail price of a new one?

Amazon is currently pricing this configuration at near-MSRP, with only the Silver dipping slightly to $1,240. While the price has been lower before, since the price increase we haven't seen Amazon drop below $1,149 on a new one, and even then it was only a brief flash deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop down to nearly $100 off at Amazon

I'll say this much — the two best smartwatch configurations to buy right now at Amazon are both down nearly $100, and that's the Natural Titanium or Black Milanese Loop Apple Watch Ultra 3.

While the cheaper Ocean Band configuration with $100 off has ended, Amazon is now selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop at $799.99 with free shipping.

Considering the Milanese Loop carries an MSRP of $899, both configurations below are down nearly $100 at Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)

Apple is expected to unveil its next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but RAM price increases have already hit the iPad and MacBook lines, and the new Apple Watch could be affected too. The current lineup hasn't seen the impact yet, but since they're essentially mini computers worn on the wrist, the Ultra 4 or Series 12 could join the price hike at any time.

We certainly wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait and see what Apple has in store for September, but with less than a month to go, these prices could increase further at any moment.

Series models are also expected to maintain their current pricing, with their $100 discounts still live at Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Grab the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable at an Amazon all-time low of $18 (40% off) with free shipping for Prime members

While the 240W Black version is still holding steady at its $18 all-time low with free Prime shipping, you'll want to grab these 10-foot Beats woven USB-C cables quickly.

Amazon is now pricing the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C woven cable at $18.03 with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 models feature upgraded power delivery specs and retail for $30, which is honestly quite pricey even for a premium 10-foot USB-C cable. But at 40% off MSRP, I think everyone should keep a few of these premium and stylish cables in their everyday carry or home collection.

Today's lead low price is the Bolt Black colorway, but there's also Navy at $19, Surge Stone at $20.85 after clipping the on-page coupon, and Red just under $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to a powerful 240W power delivery, extended to 10 feet in length, while maintaining the same tangle-resistant woven design: "More durable, more convenient. Upgrade your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, bends, and wear — choose our reinforced woven cable."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular, from $299 with $100 off

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand drops back to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

After testing it earlier this year, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become an essential part of my everyday carry, travel kit, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab it at the lowest price we've tracked at Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon Store is now selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger at $99.97 with free shipping.

This charging accessory retails for $150 and features 3-in-1 functionality, with the MagSafe pad offering up to 25W output. Both the Phantom Black and Glacial White versions are at nearly 35% off MSRP.

This week's deal matches what we mentioned before, aligning with Anker's big summer sale event and this year's Prime Day pricing.

While this accessory is compact and portable, it has some weight to it, so it sits solidly on a desk or nightstand, performing excellently whether you're working from home or out and about.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Belkin's all-new ultra-compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable only $25
  • Power all your desk devices for just $60 — SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop charger with built-in dual cables only $33 (58% off)
  • Acer woven USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supporting 240W charging, 8K and more only $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display today only $56
  • Top pick: All-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with ultra-wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent "Ghost" SmartCard Find My wallet tracker drops back to Amazon low
  • Spigen Mini MagSafe iPhone Pouch/everyday carry organizer only $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter works in "over 200 countries and regions" only $20

Official Apple Refurbished Store drops MacBook Neo to lowest prices, up to $120 off MSRP

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lines, Apple's more affordable all-new MacBook Neo also saw a recent price increase, but you can sidestep that markup through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store — the MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but through Apple's top-tier refurbished shop you can grab configurations with full Apple warranty starting from $599.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we've seen at any reputable retailer, with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's "rigorous" refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799)

While the Apple Refurbished Store product pages don't seem to show any special promotions, all models are at least $100 below current MSRP — the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below current MSRP and $20 below the previous pricing.

Yes, these are refurbished units, and yes, they only bring the price back close to the old MSRP, but this is the lowest you can get on the most affordable MacBook in the current generation.

For some people, choosing a refurbished unit to save $100 to $120 might not be worth it, and we totally understand — but the savings are absolutely significant, and we're talking about the highest quality refurbished units directly from Apple.
